producer_report.summary: Added `athena check-reading --request <file> --reading <file>`. It prints `accept` or `refuse: <reason>` (exit 0 or 1) using the same acceptance rules as the reader's own check (`decide_stored` over `check_reading_acceptance`). Once a candidate's checks pass, verification builds the base and the candidate and replays the newest 50 requests that have an accepted reading through the `check-reading` of each. It lists what only the candidate refuses and makes no model call. More than 10% newly refused turns a Pass into Fail through the new pure `verify::hold_for_replay`, which adds an Athena Blocker finding naming the list, so the job is Rejected and not landed. `HOLD_PERCENT = 10` is a code constant. If a criterion states a percent above 10, says refuse, and says it is intended, that percent replaces the limit; the replay is recorded either way. The result is stored as a new typed record, `athena.replay/1` at `<job>/replay.json`, which the records check accepts; no `replay.md` is created. A skipped replay (empty history, nested run, failed check, failed build, base without the subcommand) is recorded as `no_replay: <reason>`, never a pass. The verifier brief gets a bounded 'Reading-rule replay' section (at most 20 listed entries, 160 characters per reason, 6 KiB in all) with the count, total and list, or `no replay: <reason>`. A one-line `store.rs` arm keeps `Records::load` from panicking on the new record. A `#[cfg(test)]` override map in `run/mod.rs`, keyed by repository directory, supplies the deciders in front of tree resolution and the probe, so fixture repositories reach the hold. There is no skip switch. fmt, clippy with warnings denied, the full test suite and the policy scan all pass.

checks_run.note: 7 tests: decide_stored agreement, stricter candidate list, newest 50, empty history, hold table, intended_rate near-misses, BinaryDecide with stub executables
7 tests including the new hold, land, no-history and no-model-call pipeline tests

criteria_check.criterion: A new `athena check-reading` subcommand takes a stored request and reading and prints accept or refuse with the reason, using the same acceptance rules as reading.rs; a fixture test shows it (cargo test -p athena-cli).
criteria_check.evidence: Added `Command::CheckReading` and `check_reading` in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, which calls `athena_core::reading::decide_stored`, a wrapper over `check_reading_acceptance`. `cargo test -p athena-cli check_reading` passes. It checks that a governance-naming request prints `refuse: <exact rule text>` with code 1, that adding athena.toml to out_of_scope prints `accept` with code 0, that bad or missing files give an Err, and that clap parses the subcommand.

criteria_check.criterion: A test builds a candidate-like rule change over fixture records and shows the newly refused requests (refused by candidate, accepted by base) are listed with the count (cargo test -p athena-core).
criteria_check.evidence: `replay_tests::a_stricter_candidate_rule_lists_what_it_newly_refuses` in reading.rs. The candidate adds one refusal on top of the real rules. The newly refused list is exactly jobs 2, 3 and 5 of 6, and job 4, which the base also refuses, is absent. The summary reads '3 of 6 replayed readings newly refused: ...'. Passes under `cargo test -p athena-core --lib replay_tests`.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows the replay uses only the newest 50 requests that have accepted readings, and that an empty history gives 'no replay: <reason>' and not a pass (cargo test -p athena-core).
criteria_check.evidence: `replay_tests::history_uses_newest_fifty_that_have_an_accepted_reading_and_a_request` builds 60 accepted jobs, 3 unaccepted, 1 without a request and the current job. It gets exactly the newest 50 accepted ones, newest first. `replay_tests::history_empty_is_no_replay_and_not_a_pass` gives a NoReplay whose summary starts with 'no replay: ', held() false and is_pass() false. Both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows more than 10% newly refused is held with the list, exactly 10% or less is not held, and a candidate whose criteria intend a higher rate is not held, with the replay still recorded (cargo test -p athena-core).
criteria_check.evidence: `replay_tests::hold_is_over_ten_percent_unless_the_criteria_intend_more` is a table over 50 cases. 6 refused (12%) is held. 5 (exactly 10%), 0 and 1 are not held. 20 (40%) with an intended 30% is held. 12 (24%) with the intended 30% is not held, yet the full list, summary and a valid `Replay` record are still produced. 1 of 4 (25%) is held. A separate near-miss test covers `intended_rate`. All pass.

criteria_check.criterion: A pipeline test, with the override in front of tree resolution and the subcommand probe, holds a candidate over the threshold (Rejected, not landed); the typed replay record and the Athena Blocker finding name the list, and the records check accepts the job directory; no replay.md is created (cargo test -p athena-core).
criteria_check.evidence: `produce_and_verify_order_tests::a_replay_over_the_threshold_is_held_and_recorded_and_the_candidate_does_not_land`. The `#[cfg(test)]` REPLAY_OVERRIDE is read in `replay_for_job` before `resolve_tree`, the probe and the builds. The state is Rejected and README.md at HEAD is unchanged. The Athena Blocker finding's evidence contains all 3 job ids. `<job>/replay.json` parses through `check_record_file` with 12 replayed, 3 refusals and held true. `Records::load` has an empty `invalid` list. `replay.md` is absent. The verifier brief contains '3 of 12'. A sibling test lands with an identical pair and records 0 of 12.

criteria_check.evidence: New record kind `athena.replay/1` (`Replay`, `ReplayRefusal`, `AnyRecord::Replay`) in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs. `a_replay_round_trips_and_belongs_at_replay_json_and_nowhere_else` checks the schema string, the to_json/parse round-trip, `check_record_file` accepting `<job>/replay.json`, Misplaced at `replay-1.json`, and `replay.md` still UnknownFile. `a_skipped_replay_round_trips_and_an_inconsistent_one_is_refused` covers the validate rules. `cargo test -p athena-data replay` passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A pipeline test shows model call counts are equal for a run with a candidate rule change and a run without one, so the replay makes no model call (cargo test -p athena-core).
criteria_check.evidence: `produce_and_verify_order_tests::a_replay_makes_no_model_call` runs one job where the candidate newly refuses 3 of 12 (Rejected) and one where it refuses none (Landed). criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs shows the verifier brief carries the replay summary (newly refused count, total, list) or `no replay: <reason>`, and stays within its size limit with a very long list (cargo test -p athena-context).

open_issues: Departure from the plan's file list: crates/athena-core/src/store.rs changed by one line (the `job_of` arm for `AnyRecord::Replay`). This is the plan's own decision 2, and `Records::load` would panic without it.

The real build path (`replay_with_builds`, `build_replay_binary`) is covered only by the stub-executable decider tests and `resolve_tree`/`probe_subcommand` tests. No test runs a real `cargo build` of two trees; the pipeline tests use the override.
The `replay_skip` paths ('checks failed', 'nested run') have no pipeline test, because the fixture capability's only check always passes. The empty-history skip is tested.
This change cannot replay against its own base, which has no `check-reading`, so its own landing records `no replay: base lacks check-reading`.
A replay of a job whose candidate build reuses the checks' CARGO_TARGET_DIR is assumed safe. How the checks' environment sets that variable was not read.
The previous-result rule needs earlier attempts and is not replayed, so a change to only that rule is uncovered.
The athena-gate closing-commit check was not read; I did not verify that it allows a `replay.json` in a job's closing commit. `Records::load` and the records check accept it.
mistakes: I first used a `sample_reading` helper that did not exist and fixtures without deliverables, so the first CLI test failed; both are fixed.
Two pipeline-test assertions were wrong at first (the brief key and the order of the newest-first list); both are fixed.
learnings: Records::load keys a job's briefs by the file name without .md (for example `brief-verifier`).
Records::load's `job_of` panics on a job record kind it does not map, so the new `AnyRecord::Replay` needed one arm there.
check_governance_coverage returns Ok when a reading has no deliverables, so fixtures that must be refused need at least one.
JobId::parse checks the date and time, so fixture ids need seconds below 60.
The producer's Bash policy forbids pipes and tail, grep and wc, so use `cargo test -q` and the Grep and Read tools.
A cargo build into the verifier snapshot must use a CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside it, or the snapshot would look changed.
desires: A way to run a single test filter across several crates at once, or to see only failures, without the long empty-test lines from `cargo test` across every target.

A fixture capability with a configurable check, so the pipeline test could cover 'a failing check marked pre-existing still replays' and 'a non-pre-existing failure records no replay: checks failed' without hand-building a new capability.
